scope: Front/rear supported grip cohort; qualify image-only anatomy before bounded fusion
oldTestPolicy: Earlier test sets remain regression-only; none enter fitting or checkpoint selection
trainingCandidates: Existing surface-v2 train sources unchanged; supported views only. New validation development groups frozen before fitting; two-pass reviewed automatic hand crops.
unclearPolicy: Directly reviewed unclear crops supervise a separate clear-visibility head, not a fourth anatomical surface
labels: Two explicit pixel review passes with disagreements adjudicated; surface never derived from grip or athlete view; not independent human gold labels
localization: Existing frozen SDK and automatic observed-wrist fallback; no manually localized validation/test inputs
samplingSeconds: See bound per-source mining intake and original frame/PTS references
candidates: MobileNetV3-small heads then full encoder fine-tuning
MobileNetV3-small heads then last encoder blocks fine-tuning
selection: Known-surface equal-class/equal-video validation NLL plus 0.25 visibility NLL; validation-only calibration; fresh test unread until final model frozen
fusion: Only after surface validation gate passes: freeze image encoder; fit RGB-only neutral probability and RGB binary-grip heads; bounded palm/dorsum x front/rear correction changes overhand-vs-underhand odds only. Neutral probability must be exactly invariant to supplied view.
testSelection: At most four supported videos per grip/view cell in recording SHA order, before hand pixels or classifier scores; no replacements after crop review; missing and invalid inputs retained
storage: Reuse cached publisher archive and existing fitting pixels. Bound native extraction to selected videos, check free space before export, clean compiler caches between jobs, retain evidence/models/labels.

trainingAddendum.groupPolicy: All angles and clips of each publisher athlete stay in validation; Legion oblique clips retained as unsupported inputs, not coverage

trainingCorrection: Equal class/source-group loss per head via importance correction against sampled batch probabilities; keep positive and negative quality learning represented
